spec_match.rationale: Runs the legacy bootstrap processor, the shared port, and the 'port' in AudioWorklet.prototype switch, each in a fresh AudioContext. A reader processor confirms the route by reading globalThis.sharedConfig.

interactive.rationale: Three run buttons append to a results table.

edge_cases.rationale: The shared path reports 'not available' instead of silently falling back. Covers timeouts, processorOptions' lack of a transfer list, ordering races, and closing contexts.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 headless with --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required, default and with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features (and separately --enable-blink-features=AudioWorkletSharedPort): 'port' in AudioWorklet.prototype is false in all of them, so only the labelled fallback branches ran. Both viewports, every control exercised, console/network clean, 0px overflow. Legacy and auto→legacy delivered the config via 'bootstrap AudioWorkletProcessor', and the shared path reported unavailable.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts each path, expecting an explicit error for the shared path when unsupported.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled buttons, aria-disabled while running, and a status line.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Fixed a measured 91px mobile overflow (pre blocks in grid) with min-width:0. Now 0px.

openQuestions.title: Verify the shared-port branches on Chrome 160+ or Firefox 138+
openQuestions.detail: The shared-port code (scope port.onmessage, audioWorklet.port.postMessage with transfer) is written to the spec IDL but could not run in Chrome 153. Run every concept on a supporting build and confirm the ping/pong, the reader seeing 'AudioWorkletGlobalScope.port', a single message per table change, and the pipe via audioWorklet.port.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Controls should be at least 44x44 CSS px on touch screens, and components should adapt to their container so nothing overflows.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons, selects, inputs and ranges have min-height 44px. Selects inside .field are width:100% after a measured 117px overflow at 360px caused by long option text. Every page was re-measured at 0px overflow at 360x740 and 1280x800.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: drive.js runs: overflow=0 on every page/viewport; responsive-check desktop ok 1/1, mobile ok 1/1

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native controls with labels. Announce discrete outcomes through polite status/log regions and keep rapidly changing values out of live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every control is a native button/select/input with a visible label. Outcomes go to role=status / role=log regions. High-frequency readouts (slider positions, meters) use aria-live=off and announce only on change of state.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive grid of readouts collapsing to one column
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use grid with min-width:0 children and let tracks collapse on narrow containers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Fact/readout grids are one column below 640px and min-width:0 on grid children. A measured 91px overflow from <pre> blocks in a 2-column grid was fixed with .cmp > div { min-width: 0 }.

summary: Migration guidance made runnable: the old bootstrap hack and the shared port side by side, plus the feature-detected production pattern.
